02/11.04.2025 Heard the parties.

This application has been filed for quashing of entire criminal proceeding as well as First Information Report of Hunterganj P.S. Case No.125 of 2024, registered under Sections 376, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Sri Milan Kumar, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Chatra.
From perusal of written report, it appears that there is specific allegation against the petitioner that he has raped the victim, who is his sister-in-law.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has filed this application for quashing only on the ground that the medical report does not corroborates the allegation.
No case for quashing of the First Information Report of Hunterganj P.S. Case No.125 of 2024 is made out.
